shock.documented_insufficiency: Policy-rate, input-price and funding-disruption shocks are covered by control series, but the two spread series that carry funding-market disruption for pre-2023 episodes (ICE BofA high-yield and investment-grade option-adjusted spreads) are licensed and the public endpoint returns only a rolling three-year window. Technological obsolescence and asset-collateral shocks have no public index for the asset classes involved.

transmission.documented_insufficiency: Bank exposure is covered by supervisory aggregates. Insurer, leveraged-fund, retirement look-through and network-concentration measures require N-PORT parsing, statutory filings and a relationship graph built to a uniform standard across episodes, none of which exists yet. Index and passive weights require an index-provider licence.

blocking_reasons: causal roles with no measured evidence in an accepted episode: activated_stress
debt and fixed-obligation ratios not observed: fixed_obligations_to_external_cash
control series in accepted episodes are latest-revision, not point-in-time: commercial_industrial_loans, real_personal_consumption, unemployment_rate
evidence_scope: finalized builds and frozen control snapshots of accepted episode runs only
